title_or_table: American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B23001, Sex by Age by Employment Status for the Population 16 Years and Over
universe_or_base: Population 16 years and over, by sex and the table's 13 age groups; in_labor_force counts the employed, the unemployed and the armed forces
unit: population and in_labor_force in people, with 90 percent margins of error; participation_pct is in_labor_force as a percent of population, computed by the studio from the two counts and rounded to one decimal
qualification: Survey estimates; participation_pct is the studio's division of two published counts, so it carries no published margin of error. The ACS counts a person in the labor force if they worked or looked for work in the reference week

sex.description: male or female, as the table labels them

population.description: people 16 and over in the group

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B23001, employment status by sex and age, 2025, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Survey estimates; rates computed by Oath & Action from the table's counts.
